executable_identity.scope: Program headers, loaded segments, all non-debug sections, executable/data bytes, relocations and non-debug symbol fields are identical. Only unallocated debug sections and values of symbols referring to debug sections may differ. Full binary hashes remain distinct. This comparison is used only for unchanged auxiliary kernels.
